summary: Comprehensive testing of Site Analytics feature for IDunnoPoetry. All 16 backend API tests passed (100%). All 13 frontend UI components verified working. Page tracking and admin analytics are fully functional.
seed_data_creation: ~558 page views in database including historical data spread across 30+ days
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site Analytics feature fully tested. Backend APIs: POST /api/analytics/track (records page views with visitor_id, path, referrer, session_id), GET /api/admin/site-analytics (requires admin auth, supports 'days' query param for 7/14/30/90 day ranges). Frontend: usePageTracking hook fires on route changes (excludes admin paths), AdminSiteAnalytics page at /admin/site-analytics with all charts and metrics, Site Traffic nav item with Globe icon in admin sidebar.
